test_cases.description: extractYouTubeVideoId must correctly parse video IDs containing hyphens and underscores, not just alphanumeric characters, since valid YouTube IDs use [a-zA-Z0-9_-]
test_cases.input_description: A YouTube URL with a video ID like 'Ab_-Cd3f5Gh'
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returns the 11-char ID including hyphens and underscores

test_cases.description: extractYouTubeVideoId must handle the www-prefixed https watch URL format, ensuring the www. prefix does not break extraction
test_cases.input_description: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XXXXXXXXXXX (a different 11-char ID than visible tests use)
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returns the exact 11-char ID

test_cases.description: extractYouTubeVideoId should handle youtu.be URLs with optional www prefix, since the regex allows (www.)?
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returns 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' since www.youtu.be is valid per the pattern

test_cases.description: extractYouTubeVideoId must not extract IDs from already-embedded URLs (youtube.com/embed/...) — it only supports watch and short URL formats
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returns empty string since embed URLs are not a recognized input pattern

test_cases.description: extractYouTubeVideoId must return empty string for YouTube playlist URLs that lack a watch?v= parameter
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returns empty string

test_cases.description: extractYouTubeVideoId must return exactly 11 characters for any valid URL, not more even if the URL path continues after the ID
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returns exactly 11-character string 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must render the actual props.code text dynamically, not a hardcoded string — verified by using a unique code string not in visible tests
test_cases.expected_output_description: The <code> element contains the exact provided code string
assertions: code element text matches the provided code string exactly

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must not render a description label when description is an empty string (not just undefined), treating empty string the same as omitted
test_cases.expected_output_description: No description label element is rendered
assertions: no description/label element is present in the DOM

test_cases.description: CodeBlock copy button must pass the exact props.code value to navigator.clipboard.writeText, not a trimmed or modified version
test_cases.expected_output_description: clipboard.writeText is called with the exact string including whitespace
assertions: writeText called with exact code string including whitespace

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must render an actual <button> element (not just a clickable div) for the copy action, ensuring proper accessibility
test_cases.expected_output_description: A <button> element is present in the rendered output
assertions: a button role or button element exists in the rendered tree

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must correctly render multiline code strings preserving newlines, not collapsing them
test_cases.expected_output_description: The code element contains text with newlines preserved
assertions: rendered code text contains newline characters or multiple lines

test_cases.description: VersionBadge must dynamically render any componentName and version, not hardcode values from visible tests
test_cases.expected_output_description: Rendered text contains both 'DataGrid' and '4.2.0-beta.1'

test_cases.description: VersionBadge must render as an inline element (span or similar), not a block-level element, since the contract specifies inline display
test_cases.expected_output_description: The root element is a span or other inline element
assertions: root element tag is span or has display:inline

test_cases.description: YouTubeEmbed must dynamically construct the embed URL from any valid video ID, not hardcode a specific embed URL
test_cases.expected_output_description: iframe src is 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/L_jWHffIx5E'

test_cases.description: YouTubeEmbed must convert any youtu.be short URL to the correct embed format, not just the specific IDs used in visible tests
test_cases.expected_output_description: iframe src is 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/9bZkp7q19f0'

test_cases.description: YouTubeEmbed must always produce an https embed URL regardless of whether the input URL was http or https
test_cases.expected_output_description: iframe src starts with 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/'

test_cases.description: YouTubeEmbed must have the iframe nested inside the wrapper div (not as a sibling), ensuring the aspect-video container properly wraps the iframe
test_cases.expected_output_description: The div with aspect-video class contains the iframe as a descendant
assertions: iframe is a child/descendant of the div with aspect-video class

test_cases.description: YouTubeEmbed iframe allow attribute must contain all five required permissions as specified in the contract
test_cases.expected_output_description: allow attribute includes accelerometer, autoplay, clipboard-write, encrypted-media, gyroscope, picture-in-picture

test_cases.description: CalloutBox must render the exact text from props.text dynamically, not hardcode text from visible tests
test_cases.input_description: props.variant = 'tip', props.text = 'Remember to invalidate the cache after deploying version 3.x'
test_cases.expected_output_description: The exact text string appears as visible content
assertions: text 'Remember to invalidate the cache after deploying version 3.x' is visible

test_cases.description: CalloutBox gotcha variant must not use green/teal classes (which belong to tip), ensuring variant styles don't leak across variants
test_cases.expected_output_description: Container classes do not include green/teal color tokens
assertions: container className does not contain 'green' or 'teal'

test_cases.description: CalloutBox tip variant must not use red/orange classes (which belong to gotcha), ensuring variant styles are properly isolated
test_cases.expected_output_description: Container classes do not include red/orange color tokens
assertions: container className does not contain 'red' or 'orange'

test_cases.description: CalloutBox warning variant must use yellow/amber classes exclusively, not green/teal or red/orange classes from other variants
test_cases.expected_output_description: Container classes contain yellow or amber but not green/teal/red/orange
assertions: container className does not contain 'green' or 'teal'
container className does not contain 'red' or 'orange'

test_cases.description: CalloutBox text must be rendered inside the variant-styled container element, not as a detached sibling
test_cases.input_description: props.variant = 'warning', props.text = 'Unique text for nesting check 42'
test_cases.expected_output_description: The text is a descendant of the element that has the variant-specific classes
assertions: text is within the styled container element

test_cases.description: Barrel must export all five type aliases (CalloutVariant, CodeBlockProps, VersionBadgeProps, YouTubeEmbedProps, CalloutBoxProps) so consumers can import them
test_cases.input_description: Import types from the barrel index
test_cases.expected_output_description: All five types are importable without errors

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must nest the <code> element inside the <pre> element (not the reverse or as siblings), preserving semantic HTML structure
test_cases.expected_output_description: A <code> element is a descendant of a <pre> element
assertions: code element is inside pre element

test_cases.description: YouTubeUrl validator must reject URLs where the video ID is shorter than 11 characters, enforcing the exact length requirement
test_cases.expected_output_description: Regex does not match
assertions: regex does not match the URL

test_cases.description: YouTubeUrl validator must reject URLs where the video ID is longer than 11 characters (the regex should match exactly 11 chars of [a-zA-Z0-9_-])
test_cases.expected_output_description: Regex does not match the full string as a valid YouTube URL (or matches only up to 11 chars)
assertions: full string does not fully match the regex pattern for valid YouTube URLs

test_cases.description: extractYouTubeVideoId must handle watch URLs where v is not the first query parameter, since real YouTube URLs can have other params before v
test_cases.expected_output_description: Returns 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must render description text containing special characters (HTML entities, angle brackets) without escaping issues
test_cases.input_description: props.code = 'echo test', props.description = 'Install the <latest> version & configure'
test_cases.expected_output_description: Description text is rendered with the special characters visible
assertions: description text containing angle brackets and ampersand is visible

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must correctly render code containing HTML-like characters (<, >, &) without them being interpreted as HTML
test_cases.input_description: props.code = 'if (a < b && c > d) { return a & b; }'
test_cases.expected_output_description: The code element text contains the literal < > & characters
assertions: code text contains '<' and '>' and '&' as literal text

test_cases.description: YouTubeEmbed must correctly set the iframe title attribute when the title contains special characters like quotes or ampersands
test_cases.expected_output_description: iframe title attribute contains the exact title string
assertions: iframe title matches the provided title with special characters
